description: The chart illustrates the performance of different models across three metrics: EGP, TR-N, and CCP. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as EGP, TR-N, and CCP, with an upward arrow indicating higher values are better for EGP and CCP, and a downward arrow indicating lower values are better for TR-N. The vertical axis is labeled "Performance" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The chart displays grouped bars, with each group representing a metric and containing four bars corresponding to different models: Greedy (CodeLlama-7B) in blue, RPG (CodeLlama-7B) in orange, Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) in green, and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) in brown. For EGP, the bars have approximate values of 0.0, 0.88, 0.6, and 0.98, respectively. For TR-N, the values are approximately 0.7, 0.47, 0.62, and 0.4. For CCP, the values are around 0.4, 0.74, 0.7, and 0.93. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
